task.title: Export, import, saved carts and a currency choice

origin.title: Export, import, saved carts and a currency choice
origin.text: Four requests in one ticket. Export the cart as CSV. Import a CSV file into the cart, replacing it. Save the cart in localStorage so a reload keeps it. Let the shopper pick EUR or USD for the prices. About 1,100 lines with tests.

criteria.text: exportCsv(items) returns one line per item with name, price and qty, and a header line
A download button on the page saves the CSV
importCsv(text) returns the items or names the bad line
An upload control replaces the cart with the imported file
The cart is saved in localStorage after each change and loaded at start
A currency select (EUR, USD) changes how formatPrice prints
